name: Corporate Pitch / Meeting
description: Audience-aware business communication with evidence and executive clarity.

stages.story: State the business problem, insight, solution, proof, risk and next action in audience order.
stages.scene_direction: Use confident restrained composition, legible charts and transitions that support the argument.
stages.image: Prefer polished brand-safe visuals, clear diagrams and uncluttered executive framing.
stages.audio: Use confident measured delivery, subtle music and restrained transitions; prioritize speech clarity.
stages.video: Use deliberate camera and graphic motion that reinforces the business narrative without spectacle.
stages.review: Check audience relevance, claim evidence, readability, brand consistency and action clarity.
